about.title: About Me
about.bio: Final-year EPITECH student and passionate full-stack developer. I bridge pedagogy and production—mentoring MSc students by day, building scalable web and cloud solutions by night. Currently seeking a full-time role starting September 2025, ideally in Asia, where I can blend technical excellence with cultural curiosity.

achievements: Implemented a facial-recognition attendance system, streamlining tracking for staff and students.
Introduced modern frameworks into the MSc curriculum, enhancing student readiness for industry demands.
Modernized project deployment pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes, and Jenkins.
Improved student coding proficiency through targeted support and guidance.
Coordinated educational activities to align with Epitech's academic goals.
Migrated the internal billing system to Nuxt, reducing page load times by 50%.
Increased test coverage by 30%, ensuring the robustness of the new architecture.
Built a company-wide intranet, significantly improving inter-departmental communication.
Managed project timelines using Agile methodologies to ensure on-time delivery.
